deals.notes: FGB is shown on the NYSE (8-K cover page) but no excerpt states that AOD's shares trade on an exchange, so both_listed is null. The special meeting set for 2024-02-20 was adjourned repeatedly (to Mar 7, Apr 18, May 30, Jun 18, Jul 11, Jul 25, Aug 22 and Aug 29 2024) amid an opposing solicitation by Saba Capital; the 2024-08-29 8-K press release reports the proposal not approved. FGB then proposed a different reorganization (into an ETF, see the second deal) and later filed an N-8F stating Merger, which names no acquirer in the excerpt and settles nothing for this deal.

The 2025-08-04 N-8F ticks Merger with board vote Sept 8-9, 2024 and shareholder vote May 5, 2025.
